common.why1_title: A track record that holds up

index.hero_sub: Maksims OÜ has provided accounting, tax and legal services in Tallinn for more than 30 years.
index.svc1_body: Financial accounting and consultation, preparation of financial, tax, statistical and internal reports.
index.svc2_body: Tax planning and consulting, tax residency registration in Estonia, preparation of tax applications.
index.svc3_body: Establishment, transformation and liquidation of companies, changes to Commercial Register data, drafting and analysis of contracts.
index.svc4_body: Financial analysis of economic activity, execution of business plans, staff recruitment, obtaining activity licences.
index.svc5_body: HR documentation management, drafting of documents, certified translations, archiving of documents.
index.aud_lede: The same four services, applied differently depending on who you are — a local company, a foreign-owned firm, or an apartment association.
index.aud1_body: Established businesses and fast-growing small companies alike — accounting and reporting solid enough to hold up under a tax audit.
index.aud2_body: Estonia's 0% tax on undistributed profit draws founders here from around the world. We handle bookkeeping fully remotely, and can provide a registered legal address and contact-person service where the board sits entirely outside Estonia.
index.aud3_body: Bookkeeping, reporting and clear communication with the board, residents and service providers.
index.proc_title: From first conversation to first report
index.proc1_body: We talk through your company, document volume and the services you need.
index.proc2_body: We prepare a quote based on your actual workload, not a standard price list.
index.proc3_body: We take over records from your previous accountant (mid-year too) or set up accounting from scratch.
index.proc4_body: We keep the books, file reports on time and keep you informed.
index.faq1_a: Yes. Year-end isn't a requirement — we review the past months for accuracy and continue without any gaps.
index.faq2_q: Do you work with e-residency companies and foreign owners?
index.faq2_a: Yes. A large share of our clients are e-residency or foreign-owned companies — all communication and document exchange happens electronically, and where needed we can act as the company's contact person in Estonia.
index.faq3_q: What languages do you communicate and keep records in?
index.faq3_a: Official reporting is filed in Estonian, but internal communication and documents can be in Estonian, Russian or English — whichever suits you.
index.faq4_a: HR documentation (employment contracts, internal orders), drafting and archiving company documents, and certified translations — everything a business needs for day-to-day administration in Estonia.
index.faq5_a: Yes — we partner with Töötukassa and host accounting trainees every year.

teenused.page_title: Accounting, tax, legal, business and administrative services — under one partner
teenused.page_intro: Five service areas that can be combined to fit your company's needs — from day-to-day bookkeeping to legal and business consulting.
teenused.svc1_p1: Accounting service provided by our company is not just everyday primary bookkeeping and preparation of tax and financial reports. Among our clients are large companies and companies just starting out, public and non-commercial institutions, including apartment associations.
teenused.svc2_p1: We provide a full range of taxation related consulting services — efficient business solutions with full knowledge of the benefits and risks of each transaction.
teenused.svc2_p2: From the year 2000, 0% tax rate on undistributed corporate income in Estonia has been attracting entrepreneurs from different countries. Together with partners abroad we also provide consultations on international tax planning.
teenused.svc2_li4: Preparation of income declarations for private persons
teenused.svc2_li5: Registration of tax residents in Estonia
teenused.svc2_li7: Representation of a client in Tax Department
teenused.svc2_li8: Preparation of applications for Tax Department (Tax-free, VAT, etc.)
teenused.svc3_p1: We provide legal support for Estonian companies, specialising in corporate, commercial and labour law.
teenused.svc3_p2: Zero tax on undistributed profit and no mandatory share capital contribution make Estonia attractive for international tax planning. We offer a full range of services from company registration to liquidation.
teenused.svc3_li2: Legal address and contact person of the company
teenused.svc4_p1: Based on our extensive experience in different areas of activity, we offer services related to financial, economic and investment activities, and solve unique business problems.
teenused.svc5_p1: Organisation of documentation management has a great effect on the economic activity of a company — receiving, preparing, using and storing documents.

ettevottest.page_intro: Maksims OÜ is a Tallinn-based accounting and business office that has helped Estonian companies since 1993.
ettevottest.about_p1: Maksims OÜ was founded in 1993. Over the years of our operation we have supported many Estonian-registered companies on a range of accounting matters, as well as legal topics.
ettevottest.about_p2: Over the years we have acquired unique experience and developed our own system for organising and running accounting records, which allows us to provide clients with the necessary information and financial statements quickly and accurately, and to offer accounting services of the highest standard.
ettevottest.about_p3: We provide a full range of taxation-related consulting services. We offer and develop efficient and comprehensive business solutions with full knowledge of the benefits and risks that may occur during a transaction. We also provide legal services in commercial law, including registration, reorganisation, merger, division and liquidation of Estonian companies.
ettevottest.about_p4: The high professional level of Maksims staff, their responsible, proper and attentive approach to clients' problems, the timely and precise fulfilment of contractual obligations, and successful experience passing tax and audit inspections have enabled us to win clients' trust and build a reputation as a professional, reliable partner. Our regular clients know how calm and easy it is to work with us. We guarantee quality service at a reasonable price.
ettevottest.career_p1: We will be glad to see in our team either young professionals who wish to start building their career in our company or experienced professionals with a background in finance, economics and accounting.
ettevottest.career_p2: We offer excellent career opportunities, including a competitive salary, for hard-working, self-motivated, friendly and initiative employees.
ettevottest.training_p1: We offer an opportunity to undergo accounting job training with us — we share our experience and knowledge, giving trainees practical accounting experience and improving their competitiveness in the jobs market. We also partner with Töötukassa for this.
ettevottest.training_p2: You will have the opportunity of future employment at the end of a successful job training.

privaatsus.meta_description: How Maksims OÜ processes personal data submitted through this website.
privaatsus.page_intro: This policy explains what personal data Maksims OÜ collects through this website and how it is processed.
privaatsus.p_controller: Maksims OÜ, Kentmanni 18-45, 10116 Tallinn, Estonia. Email: info@maksims.ee, phone +372 6 270 750.
privaatsus.p_data: Through the quote request form we collect the contact person's name, company name, email address and phone number, along with the information you enter about your business activity and document volume. We use this solely to answer your enquiry and prepare a quote. The legal basis is your consent and pre-contractual negotiations.
privaatsus.p_retention: We keep enquiry data for 3 years from the last contact, after which it is deleted. If the enquiry becomes a client relationship, the longer retention periods set out in the Accounting Act and other legislation apply.
privaatsus.p_sharing: We do not sell or share your data for marketing purposes. {{sharingProcessor}} Data may be disclosed to public authorities only where required by law.
privaatsus.p_rights: You have the right to access your data, request its correction or deletion, restrict processing, object to it, and withdraw your consent at any time. To do so, write to info@maksims.ee. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate (www.aki.ee).
privaatsus.p_cookies: This website uses no tracking or marketing cookies. Your language choice is stored only in your own browser (localStorage) and is not shared with anyone.
privaatsus.sharing_mailto: The website form opens your own email programme, so the enquiry reaches us directly by email without passing through any third-party service.
privaatsus.sharing_provider: Enquiries sent through the form are delivered to us by our service provider {{company.formProvider}}, solely for the purpose of delivering them.
